deploy_tree.note: The whole repository. `.github/workflows/static.yml` uploads `path: '.'` to GitHub Pages, so there is no curated file list to keep in step — an earlier version of this manifest named 8 files and had fallen 17 behind.

vercel.note: Still building pull-request previews despite README describing vercel.json as leftover. Project name observed from PR deployment notifications, not from a Vercel API call.
vercel.cleanUrls: vercel.json sets cleanUrls with trailingSlash:false — a page named index.html inside a subdirectory loses its directory segment and its relative imports 404. celestial/overlay.html is named that way for this reason.

No `apps/` directory exists in the checkout here, so the recorded `monorepo_path: apps/crystal-interface` could not be confirmed and has not been replaced with a guess.
